Sport in Amsterdam this week

All this week's events

16 – 22 Nov · 10 events

Fun runs, matches, tournaments, open sessions and other sports events you can join or watch. Some are for beginners and casual players, others for people who already train regularly. The list is refreshed every week, so there is always a new way to move or a game to cheer at. Every listing is checked on the organiser's own page. Times and prices can change, so check the organiser's link before you go.

Showing today onwards

  1. Prikkelvrij schaatsen at Schaatsbaan Museumplein

    Sport · Active & Outdoor · Regular

    When
    Mon 16 Nov, 12:00–14:00
    Where
    Schaatsbaan Museumplein, Hobbemastraat 18, Amsterdam (Museumkwartier, Zuid)
    Price
    €8 entry, or €16 incl. skate hire
    Organiser
    Schaatsbaan Museumplein

    A quieter two-hour slot on the outdoor rink: no music or announcements, dimmed lighting and a limited number of skaters. Intended for people who need a low-stimulus setting, and open to anyone who prefers the calm. Regular tickets apply.

    Details and tickets for Prikkelvrij schaatsen at Schaatsbaan Museumplein (organiser's site)

  2. Midnight Runners — Chill Long Run

    Sport · Active & Outdoor · Regular

    When
    Mon 16 Nov, 20:00 (run starts 20:15)
    Where
    Café Parck, Overtoom 428, Amsterdam (Oud-West)
    Price
    Free; register via Heylo
    Organiser
    Midnight Runners Amsterdam

    A relaxed evening run of about 10 km at around 6:30/km, or whatever distance suits you, with music on the route. Meet at 20:00 at Café Parck; the run starts at 20:15. Bag drop is available; there are no changing rooms, so come dressed to run.

    Details and tickets for Midnight Runners — Chill Long Run (organiser's site)

  3. Samen Schaatsen at Schaatsbaan Museumplein

    Sport · Active & Outdoor · Kids & Family · Regular

    When
    Tue 17 Nov, 16:00–18:00
    Where
    Schaatsbaan Museumplein, Hobbemastraat 18, Amsterdam (Museumkwartier, Zuid)
    Price
    Free incl. skate hire; register
    Organiser
    Schaatsbaan Museumplein

    Experienced skaters are paired with beginners for a social Tuesday session on the outdoor rink. Entry and skate hire are free. It runs every Tuesday outside school holidays; sign up via the form on the organiser's page.

    Details and tickets for Samen Schaatsen at Schaatsbaan Museumplein (organiser's site)

  4. Bingsu run — Asian Run Club Amsterdam

    Sport · Active & Outdoor

    When
    Tue 17 Nov, 19:00–20:00 (arrive 18:45)
    Where
    Hongdae Amsterdam, Lange Leidsedwarsstraat 57, Amsterdam (Leidseplein, Centrum)
    Price
    Free; register
    Organiser
    asianrunclub.ams

    A 5 km group run at about 6:00/km, starting and finishing at Hongdae Amsterdam. Bag drop is available; bring lights if you have them. Arrive 15 minutes early. Optional bingsu afterwards, bill split. Register via Luma.

    Details and tickets for Bingsu run — Asian Run Club Amsterdam (organiser's site)

  5. Queerboxing — Basic Bitch Boxing at Lola Lieven

    Sport · Queer · Regular

    When
    Tue 17 Nov, 19:30–20:30
    Where
    Lola Lieven, Rodenrijsstraat 43, Amsterdam (Nieuw-West)
    Price
    Free; just walk in
    Organiser
    Lola Lieven

    A weekly free session on the basics of boxing and self-defence in a queer space: stance, punches, dodging, short combinations and games. No experience needed and no sign-up. Every Tuesday at Lola Lieven.

    Details and tickets for Queerboxing — Basic Bitch Boxing at Lola Lieven (organiser's site)

  6. Open Avond at Beest Boulders Amsterdam

    Sport · Workshops

    When
    Fri 20 Nov, 18:00–23:00
    Where
    Beest Boulders Amsterdam, Willem de Zwijgerlaan 338B, Amsterdam (West)
    Price
    €5 incl. shoes and a 1-hour workshop; reserve
    Organiser
    Beest Boulders

    A try-out evening for newcomers: after signing in at the bar you join a one-hour workshop on the basics of bouldering, then climb for the rest of the evening. Shoes are included. The same open evening also runs at Het Lab, Transformatorweg 32. Reserve online or at the gym.

    Details and tickets for Open Avond at Beest Boulders Amsterdam (organiser's site)

  7. ALO Runners Club — 6K from PC Hooftstraat

    Sport · Active & Outdoor

    When
    Sat 21 Nov, 09:30–10:30
    Where
    ALO, Pieter Cornelisz Hooftstraat 43, Amsterdam (Museumkwartier, Zuid)
    Price
    Free; register
    Organiser
    ALO

    A 6 km group run from the ALO store on PC Hooftstraat, led by Tijn Branderhorst. All paces welcome. The run goes ahead in rain or shine; there is no bag storage, so travel light. Register via Luma.

    Details and tickets for ALO Runners Club — 6K from PC Hooftstraat (organiser's site)

  8. Trailrunclinic with Hardlopen Amsterdam

    Sport · Active & Outdoor · Workshops

    When
    Sat 21 Nov, 11:00–c. 12:30
    Where
    Amsterdamse Bos — meet at the lockers beside restaurant De Bosbaan, Bosbaan 4, Amstelveen (Amsterdamse Bos)
    Price
    €30 for HA runners, €40 for others
    Organiser
    Hardlopen Amsterdam

    A 90-minute trail-running clinic around the hill in the Amsterdamse Bos: warm-up, strength, technique for climbing and descending, short intervals and a cool-down. Groups of 4 to 10, led by trainer René. Meet at the lockers next to restaurant De Bosbaan.

    Details and tickets for Trailrunclinic with Hardlopen Amsterdam (organiser's site)

  9. Bandeja Padel Tournament at NDSM Padel

    Sport

    When
    Sat 21 Nov, 17:00–22:00
    Where
    NDSM Padel, Internetstraat 3, Amsterdam (Noord)
    Price
    €25 per person (€50 per team)
    Organiser
    Bandeja Padel Spijkers

    A social padel tournament that does not count for the KNLTB ranking, with beginner, intermediate and advanced categories. You play with the partner you register with; everyone gets a group stage of three 30-minute matches, then knock-out and consolation rounds. Sign up as a pair via Bandeja Padel.

    Details and tickets for Bandeja Padel Tournament at NDSM Padel (organiser's site)

  10. EAA Bouldering at USC Universum

    Sport

    When
    Sat 21 Nov, 18:00–20:00
    Where
    USC Universum, Science Park 306, Amsterdam (Science Park, Oost)
    Price
    Free registration; USC entry €9 students / €12.50–14.50 others (book the 18:00 slot)
    Organiser
    Effective Altruism Amsterdam

    A social bouldering session at USC Universum, hosted by Effective Altruism Amsterdam. Open to beginners and experienced climbers. Registration is free; you need a USC entrance pass and should book the 18:00 slot in the My USC app. Climbing shoes can be hired at the desk.

    Details and tickets for EAA Bouldering at USC Universum (organiser's site)
